children: The intensifying run-up in diesel prices pushed futures to fresh records Monday and helped propel the 10-year yield to rise above 5% for the first time since 2023.

Average U.S. retail prices for diesel--key to shipping, farming and other backbones of the U.S. economy--already reached a record $6.23 a gallon Monday. Front-month futures recently rose to around $5.17, suggesting more pain at the pump ahead.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
